field.label: DNS Server Address
field.help: DoH: https://1.1.1.1/dns-query; DoH direct (bypasses the proxy, hairpinning rules still apply): https+local://1.1.1.1/dns-query; plain Do53: tcp://dns1.yandex.ru or an IP like 77.88.8.8 (UDP is used when no scheme is given); fakedns for the built-in fake DNS; localhost for the system resolver. DNS requests from Xray are routed with the same routing rules as ordinary traffic.

field.label: Port
field.help: Leave empty for the scheme default (DoH: 443, tcp://: 53, Do53 (UDP): 53). Only set when your server uses a custom port.

field.label: Domains this server serves
field.help: Type a rule and press Enter: domain:ru (suffix — needs no GeoData), geosite:ru (needs the matching GeoData list), geosite:category-ads-all, domain:ya.ru, full:myip.ru, regexp:.*\.ru$. Only these domains are answered by this server; empty means «everything». «domain:example.com» matches the domain itself and all its subdomains; a GeoData-free RU rule is "domain:ru, domain:xn--p1ai, domain:su".

field.label: Expected IPs (answer filter)
field.help: Accepted answers only: CIDR ranges or geoip: tags (geoip:ru, geoip:cn, 192.168.0.0/16). Answers outside the list are discarded (and the next matching server is tried). Use * to accept any (the default).

field.label: Unexpected IPs (answer filter)
field.help: Answers containing any of these CIDRs or geoip: tags are rejected (e.g. geoip:ir to keep IR answers out of an RU domestic server). Empty disables the filter.

field.label: Never use as fallback
field.help: Only for the domains this server lists — it is never used to answer other domains when every tagged server fails. This is what the «RU domestic DNS + default DoH» preset wants.
